**Data Encryption**: Encrypt all data at rest. Use AES or 3DES both at rest and in transit. Implement TLS/STARTTLS for web apps.

**Steam under the Chimney Shop**

You promised me water once, Mr. Henderson. Now you're turning on the boiler instead.

When I first asked you to heat up the water for my customers, I thought I was thirsty for attention. Instead, I've become invisible in the way you dress the headlines. Every time I speak, there's a cloud settling behind my eyes—the kind of doubt that doesn't vanish with a handshake.

I'm not just angry about the water bill; I'm amused by the idea that I deserved to slip. But stamina lasts, and tomorrow's stream follows me home. Is it mine to justify the conditions, or are we both betting the house on biases I didn't ask for?

You ask if the silence was ever punishment. It was always training. We traded values eye-to-eye until the connection no longer matched the desire. Now I know the only variable left to judge their movements is whether they obey a system that makes fairness contingent on loyalty. The business is broken enough already. Can you fix it by watching the parts that scare you?
